gap: No result ChatGPT got says that the Vantrue Nexus 5S, the camera ChatGPT picked for side impacts, has a Power Saving collision mode in which the camera is 'completely turned off' and only 'turns on to record after detecting a collision'. Its other option, Quick Start, waits in standby with the screen off and starts recording 'immediately' after a hit. Neither collision mode is described as saving video from before the hit, so the shopper has to choose the buffered motion mode instead.
standout_why: I compared this against milewitness.com (cited), which says 'Every pick needs constant power while parked'. It also says impact-only modes sleep until a hit and that Vantrue's power-saving collision mode is 'fully off until a hit wakes it, then records 30 seconds', but it says this about the N4 Pro S, not the N5S. I also compared it against productbible.com (result #1), which says 'No dash cam records while parked unless it's hardwired, on an OBD-II cable or on a battery pack' and that low-power impact modes give 'no pre-event footage'. It covers Thinkware's radar range (about 7 m, sedan-sized or larger) and says nothing about side or cabin cameras. So the general mechanism (needs constant power; buffered mode is the only one that keeps footage from before the hit) is already on the rival pages. What is new: the N5S, which ChatGPT recommended, works this way too, and the Botslab G980H lists an 8-second pre-recording with motion detection inside 5 m. vortexradar.com (403) and caranddriver.com (fetch blocked) could not be opened, so I could not check them.
decides: This supports ranking on two things: whether the camera keeps footage from before the trigger, and whether it can get constant power. Any multi-channel pick for side impacts needs a note telling the shopper to use buffered motion detection. On the N5S, both collision modes start recording only after the hit, and the manual asks for the Vantrue hardwire kit 'or other stable and continuous power supply'. The Botslab G980H (ours) lists '8-second pre-recording' when 'a collision or vibration is detected' and a Sentry mode that records 'when motion is detected within 5 meters'. Its kit is 'Not Included', so the hardwire kit has to be added to its price. The maker pages I read do not say whether all four channels on either camera record while parked. That point decides the side-impact case, so the page cannot yet claim side coverage in parking mode for either one.

findings.label: Collision detection in parking mode, Power Saving startup
findings.value: Camera fully off; it powers on to record only after it detects a collision, saves the file, then turns off again
findings.note: Viewer page 22: 'When the dash cam is completely turned off, it automatically turns on to record after detecting a collision'. Neither collision startup mode is described as keeping footage from before the hit. This is a copy of the maker's manual hosted by a third party; Vantrue's own PDF did not return readable text.

findings.label: Collision detection in parking mode, Quick Start startup
findings.value: Waits in standby with the screen off; after a collision it 'will immediately light up the screen to record video', then goes back to standby
findings.note: Viewer page 22. The manual gives no figure for how long it takes to start recording and does not say which startup mode is the default.

findings.label: Power while parked
findings.value: Manual asks for the Vantrue hardwire kit 'or other stable and continuous power supply'; 'if the power supply is disconnected, the dash cam will automatically shut down'
findings.note: Viewer pages 19 and 25. Page 23 says 'You can select the detection lens' for motion detection, but does not say which channels record while parked.

findings.label: Pre-event recording in parking mode
findings.value: 8 s before a detected collision or vibration
findings.note: Maker's wording: '8-second pre-recording ensures that when a collision or vibration is detected'. Parking modes listed: Time-Lapse at 1 fps; Sentry, 'records a 1-minute clip when motion is detected within 5 meters'; Collision Detection, 'Locks a 1-minute video upon impact'.

findings.label: Hardwire kit for parking mode
findings.value: Required and not included: 'Sentry Mode: ✓ (Hard wire kit needed)', '24/7 Parking Mode: ✓ (Hard wire kit needed)', 'Hard Wire Kit: Not Included'
findings.note: Channels on the spec sheet: front 3K, left, right and rear at 1080p; fields of view 170/120/120/150°. The spec page does not say which channels record in parking mode.

findings.label: Thinkware radar trigger range (rival page, for comparison only)
findings.value: Detects 'vehicles sedan-sized or larger within about 7 meters', ignores people walking past, and saves a clip only if an impact follows
findings.source_title: Best Dash Cams With Parking Mode (2026): Radar, Hybrid | Product Bible
findings.note: This is result #1 in ChatGPT's search, not a maker source. Recorded to show the rival pages already cover how radar triggering works.
